text: AI Platform: software platforms for artificial intelligence, including machine learning operations (MLOps) tools, generative AI frameworks, and enterprise AI integration services; AI platform; artificial intelligence platform; machine learning platform; MLOps; generative AI; AI framework; enterprise AI; AI software; AI solution
reasons: GeM categories for AI software are often vague (e.g., 'Computer Software' or 'IT Services'); specific AI platform tenders are best found via meaning-based title search rather than strict category filtering, so leaving categories empty ensures no relevant tenders in broader or mislabeled categories are excluded.
